QueryString.value: SELECT projectmeta.Project AS Project, solutionmeta.RootPackage AS RootPackage, solutionmeta.RootPackageVersion AS RootPackageVersion, projectmeta.MESVersion, projectmeta.YoGeneratorVersion, projectmeta.NGXSchematicsVersion, projectmeta.NugetVersion, projectmeta.TestScenariosNugetVersion, projectmeta.NPMRegistry, projectmeta.NuGetRegistry, solutionmeta.GlobalJsonVersion, solutionmeta.GlobalJsonStrategy, solutionmeta.CIRepository, if(solutionmeta.CIRepository = '' OR solutionmeta.CIRepository IS NULL, 'Missing', 'Configured') AS CIRepositoryStatus, solutionmeta.RepositoryCount, solutionmeta.TestPackages FROM ( SELECT Enterprise_Name AS Project, argMax(Parameters_StringValues[indexOf(Parameters_Name, 'MESVersion')][1], _created_at) AS MESVersion, argMax(Parameters_StringValues[indexOf(Parameters_Name, 'YoGeneratorVersion')][1], _created_at) AS YoGeneratorVersion, argMax(Parameters_StringValues[indexOf(Parameters_Name, 'NGXSchematicsVersion')][1], _created_at) AS NGXSchematicsVersion, argMax(Parameters_StringValues[indexOf(Parameters_Name, 'NugetVersion')][1], _created_at) AS NugetVersion, argMax(Parameters_StringValues[indexOf(Parameters_Name, 'TestScenariosNugetVersion')][1], _created_at) AS TestScenariosNugetVersion, argMax(Parameters_StringValues[indexOf(Parameters_Name, 'NPMRegistry')][1], _created_at) AS NPMRegistry, argMax(Parameters_StringValues[indexOf(Parameters_Name, 'NuGetRegistry')][1], _created_at) AS NuGetRegistry FROM PostTelemetry WHERE Area_Name = 'ProjectMetadata' GROUP BY Project ) AS projectmeta FULL JOIN ( SELECT Enterprise_Name AS Project, argMax(Site_Name, _created_at) AS RootPackage, argMax(Facility_Name, _created_at) AS RootPackageVersion, argMax(Parameters_StringValues[indexOf(Parameters_Name, 'GlobalJson Version')][1], _created_at) AS GlobalJsonVersion, argMax(Parameters_StringValues[indexOf(Parameters_Name, 'GlobalJson Strategy')][1], _created_at) AS GlobalJsonStrategy, argMax(Parameters_StringValues[indexOf(Parameters_Name, 'CIRepository')][1], _created_at) AS CIRepository, argMax(Parameters_NumericValues[indexOf(Parameters_Name, 'Number of Repositories')][1], _created_at) AS RepositoryCount, argMax(Parameters_NumericValues[indexOf(Parameters_Name, 'Number of Test Packages')][1], _created_at) AS TestPackages FROM PostTelemetry WHERE Area_Name = 'PackageMetadata' AND Tags_Value[indexOf(Tags_Key, 'PackageType')] = 'Root' GROUP BY Project ) AS solutionmeta USING (Project)
